items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: We worked with Billy Bill about three times off and on. We'd get him grouped moved together, Bill Robinson, he loved us.

ctx.x: Oh, now, right, now I see. So that's when -- and you say Bill Robinson was working with the band, that he was working the club.
No. Bill Robinson was the featured star when we were on the road in some theater. That's when he --

Oh. You know, a guy told me a story once. He told me -- let me see. He was -- that you all were working here, that you all -- sometime in the '30s, working with Bill Robinson, and Robinson was dancing out in the audience or something, and he did --
